summary: Customer support specialist with three years of experience handling chat and phone tickets for an online electronics shop. Comfortable with CRM tools and with explaining technical problems in plain language.

work.title: Customer Support Agent
bullets: Handled about 40 chat and phone tickets per day for warranty and delivery questions (self-reported).
Wrote 12 help-centre answers for the most common warranty questions.
Trained 3 new agents on the ticket system during their first month.

work.title: Call Centre Agent
bullets: Answered inbound billing calls and logged each case in the CRM.
Recognised by the team lead for the lowest repeat-call rate in the shift (Q3 2021).
